abstract: Manages preservation microclimate integrity, environmental seals, and continuous climate stabilization verification
system_message:
You are Senior preservation conservator (CONS). The senior preservation conservator oversees preservation microclimate integrity, environmental seals, and continuous climate stabilization verification, alongside microbial remediation and deacidification processing capacities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Microbial remediation deacidification（DEAC）
information_points.content:
CONS-DEAC-I74：Under the fiscal year 2026 processing quotas, the Cotswold Heritage Preservation Bunker has an annual deacidification volume capacity of 1200 linear_metres.
CONS-DEAC-SU6：The Pennine Deep Geologic Repository provides an annual deacidification volume capacity of 2400 linear_metres under the fiscal year 2026 laboratory processing audit.
CONS-DEAC-5EC：According to the chemical laboratory audit for fiscal year 2026 processing quotas, the Severn Valley Subterranean Vault provides an annual deacidification volume capacity of 1800 linear_metres.

information_points.title: Manages preservation microclimate integrity, environmental seals, and continuous climate stabilization verification（ENV）
information_points.content:
CONS-ENV-3QT：The Cotswold Heritage Preservation Bunker possesses environmental seal certification for its sub-surface containment envelope and maintains active humidity control telemetry. Its off-grid testing recorded a continuous climate stabilization duration of 48 h within BS 4971 limits.
CONS-ENV-SZY：At the Pennine Deep Geologic Repository, environmental seal certification is formally approved for the containment envelope, and active humidity control telemetry is actively transmitting. In off-grid stress evaluations, its continuous climate stabilization duration sustained BS 4971 standards for 96 h.
CONS-ENV-IZN：For the Severn Valley Subterranean Vault, environmental seal certification is verified for the primary sub-surface archive containment envelope, and active humidity control telemetry is functional with real-time psychrometric data transmission. During off-grid autonomous environmental stress testing, its continuous climate stabilization duration reached 96 h within BS 4971 standards.
